company.shortDescription: Nooks is an applied AI lab that powers modern sales teams.
company.description: Nooks is an applied AI lab that powers modern sales organizations. Our platform automates sales busywork so reps can focus on the human side of selling and generate more qualified pipeline from outbound. Sellers access a single platform for prospecting, coaching, and calling. The platform learns through AI-powered feedback loops, helping teams to be more targeted and effective in their outbound. Thousands of sales teams at companies like Hubspot, ZoomInfo, Deel, and Udemy rely on the Nooks platform.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $43,000,000, or 61.43% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $30,662,474 to $361,062,788, a 11.78x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
